Overview
A mid-engined two-seater used to be the kind of thing we all dreamed of but couldn’t ever see ourselves actually owning. But then Porsche brought along the 987 in 2006 and suddenly a mid-engined two-seater started to look like a car you could buy with your head, not just your heart.
The Cayman we have here comes with a goodly stack of servicing invoices and stamps, and a freshly squeezed MOT certificate which will take you all the way to December 2026. It has had a thorough suspension overhaul, including new rear springs in 2023, a rebuilt cylinder head in 2024, and replacement exhaust parts in 2025.
Its interior is the kind of joyously simple affair which you got back in 2007, without any touchscreens or pointless safety warnings. You simply get in, play your favourite CD, and drive off into the distance. With 240 horses galloping away there’s plenty of power to play with, and the five-speed manual transmission will keep you entertained when tackling a twisty stretch of road.
In short, there’s no reason to settle for a boring commute when there are Caymans snapping at your heels, and this one is ready to go.

Mechanical

-
Five-speed manual gearbox
-
Rear-wheel drive
-
Serviced in Oct 2025, including replacing the battery and the timing tensioner, fixing a small coolant leak, and replacing the exhaust back box with a used part
-
In Aug 2024 the engine was removed, and the cylinder head on bank 1 was skimmed and rebuilt with new valves
-
In Aug 2023 the car received new rear coil springs, front and rear lower suspension arms, track rod ends, and several brake pipes
-
The seller tells us that the car starts first time, runs smoothly ,and has excellent throttle response
-
The vendor also notes that Zunsport stainless steel grilles have been fitted to protect the replacement radiators
-
No warning lights or mechanical issues reported
Summary
Don’t let that suave dark blue exterior fool you: this is a car which is meant to be driven and enjoyed. Yes it can fit in when you’re visiting the swankier neighbourhoods about town, but it will also put on a show when you mash your right foot into the carpet. And you’ve got more than enough luggage space for wherever you might end up.
To arrange a viewing, click the 'Book Viewing' button located under the 'Place Bid' button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to 'Contact Seller' for further enquiries. This seller is located in Kelso, Scottish Borders.
